reply.text:
This is a pain symptom, so it is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach. I won't assess the neck or suggest how to train around it. If it's still stiff after a few days, or comes with numbness, tingling, or pain running into your arms, get it looked at.

When you're ready to get back to the training side, tell me which session has the shrugs and I can make the change to your program, or we can work through the rest of the week together.
